title: The Weather Today and Tomorrow
text:
Today the weather is bad. It is cold and it is raining. The sky is grey. There is a lot of wind.

Tomorrow it will be sunny. The sun will be hot in the afternoon. We can go to the park. Bring a hat.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What will the weather be tomorrow?
What should people take with them tomorrow?
Why is tomorrow a good day to go to the park?
options: It will be sunny and warm
